seven-chairs.observed_description: Seven identical light-oak slat-back chairs in one row against a white wall, all complete; countable at 180 px. Row too wide for the 4:5 crop, as planned (four_card false).

eight-books.observed_description: Only SIX blue books are shown in the row, not eight; the count contradicts the item Eight books.

nine-cars.observed_description: Nine small cars from above in one marked row (white, silver, blue, grey, red, white, blue, white, red), clear gaps, no plates; countable at 180 px.

red-bus.observed_description: One solid-red city bus in front three-quarter view, blank dark destination display, no text or logos, grey buildings behind; the 4:5 crop still shows a red bus.

blue-bike.observed_description: One bicycle with a solid bright-blue frame, black tires and seat, side view on a beige wall and concrete path; complete in both the 3:2 and 4:5 crops.

green-chair.observed_description: One slatted wooden chair painted solid green, three-quarter view on pale oak boards before a white wall; complete in the 3:2 and 4:5 crops.

yellow-bag.observed_description: One solid-yellow backpack seen from its strap side on a light-grey floor and wall; unmistakably a yellow bag in the 3:2 and 4:5 crops.

black-car.observed_description: One glossy solid-black small hatchback, front three-quarter view, blank plate area, cream wall and pale concrete; the 4:5 crop trims only the rear bumper.

white-table.observed_description: One plain white rectangular table with four white legs on brown wood floorboards before a warm-grey wall; complete and clear in both crops.

number.observed_description: A white house-number plate with large black numerals 24 on pale stone beside a wooden door; legible at 180 px; no other characters.

review-bus-number.observed_description: Front of a white and grey city bus at a stop; its amber display shows only the numeral 8, legible at 250 px and in the 4:5 crop; plate blank.

review-parking-number.observed_description: An empty parking space on dark asphalt with a large white painted 7, a silver car partly visible at the left edge; no other characters.

gate-number-8.observed_description: The park-table scene edited to keep only the 8 number card on its wooden stand; trees, lake and picnic tables unchanged in style; no other numbers.

gate-red-chair.observed_description: The terrace scene edited to keep only the red chair at the left; blue, green and yellow chairs removed cleanly; lake and wall intact. Used full-frame only.

these-books.observed_description: Four identical green books: two near with the left hand on them and the right index finger pointing at them, two far and small up the table; reads THESE.

these-phones.observed_description: Four identical black phones: left hand on the near pair, right finger pointing down at them from mid-height; far pair small up the table; reads THESE.

these-bags.observed_description: The right finger points up and left into the gap between the near and far backpacks; at phone size it reads as pointing at the far pair, so THESE is ambiguous.

which-red-bag.observed_description: Two backpacks side by side, red left and blue right; only the right hand, index finger pointing at the red one's front pocket; clear in both crops.

those-books.observed_description: The edit removed one near book: only one green book remains under the left hand, so the near pair is broken; the finger does point at the far pair.

those-phones.observed_description: Same scene as THESE phones: left hand on the near pair, both near phones intact; the right finger now points up at the far pair and stops visibly short.

which-blue-bag.observed_description: Same red and blue backpacks; only the right index finger moved and now points at the blue backpack's front pocket; red one unchanged.

those-books-alt.observed_description: Same scene as THESE books with both near books and the left hand intact; the right index finger now points straight up the table toward the far pair, short of it.

eight-books-r2.observed_description: Eight identical blank dark-blue hardcover books from above in a 4 + 4 grid with even gaps; countable at 180 px; too wide for the 4:5 crop (four_card false).

these-bags-r2.observed_description: Four identical grey backpacks lying flat: the left hand rests on the near left one and the right index finger points left at the near right one; far pair small up the table.

those-bags-r2.observed_description: The edit did not turn the finger: it still points left at the near right backpack, so the picture still means THESE; only the framing shifted slightly.

those-bags-r2-alt.observed_description: The fallback also left the finger on the near right backpack, pointing up-left at its corner rather than up the table at the far pair; still reads THESE.
